I only spent about 3 hours on this just before reading your question.  One last dispairing google suggests that this should work.  It may not be the easiest or most up-to-date method but it seems to work.


mydata  <-  data.frame(xx = 1:10, yy=1:10)

p  <-  ggplot(mydata, aes(xx , yy)) + geom_point() +
            opts( axis.text.x = theme_blank(), axis.title.x=theme_blank()) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks=NULL)

p
